_comment: Labelled questions for scripts/measure_search.py, written on 2026-10-15 before the fusion was built. Each: language, question, the parts that answer it (id prefixes). The a_or_an parts are read from the library (Ezekias's published knowledge); the others are fictional and kept here.

questions: Do I write a or an before hour?
What do I write before a word that begins with a vowel sound, like apple?
What about words that start with a consonant sound?
How do I choose before a number like 8 or 11?
Is it a FBI agent or an FBI agent?
What about NASA, which is read as a word?
I am not sure how a word sounds, what should I do?
Should I look at the first letter of the next word?
an MRI scan or a MRI scan?
Faut-il écrire a ou an devant hour ?
Que faire devant un nombre comme 8 ?
Et pour une abréviation lue lettre par lettre ?
Je ne sais pas comment se prononce un mot, que faire ?
Quel article devant un mot qui commence par un son de voyelle ?

units.text: Announce the meetup on the public channel
units.quote: I always announce a meetup two weeks ahead on the public channel.
Speakers confirm a week before, or the slot goes to the next one.

units.text: When fewer than ten people register, move the meetup.
units.quote: Under ten registrations, I move the meetup rather than run it half empty.

units.text: When a code of conduct report is made, two organisers handle it.
units.quote: A code of conduct report goes to two organisers only, never the whole team.

Que fait-on quand moins de dix personnes s'inscrivent ?

units.text: Post every invoice within five working days of receipt
units.quote: Post every invoice within five working days of receipt.

units.text: This screen shows an invoice of 6,650 euros for a CNC spindle, so it is coded as capital expenditure
units.quote: This screen shows an invoice of 6,650 euros for a CNC spindle, so it is coded as capital expenditure.

units.text: When an invoice is coded, before coding an invoice, we match it to its purchase order, so we only pay for what was ordered.
units.quote: Before coding an invoice, we match it to its purchase order, so we only pay for what was ordered.

units.text: When a single item costs more than 5,000 euros, record it as capital expenditure.
units.quote: When a single item costs more than 5,000 euros, we record it as capital expenditure.
